irregulars.explanation: For verbs ending in ㅅ, the ㅅ is dropped before adding ~ㄹ/을 겁니다.
For verbs ending in ㄷ, the ㄷ changes to ㄹ when adding ~ㄹ/을 겁니다.
For verbs ending in ㅂ, ㅂ is replaced with 우 before adding ~ㄹ/을 겁니다.
Consider the vowel in the preceding syllable to determine if ~아/어 should be applied before conjugating, though this irregular generally does not apply directly in future tense constructions.
An additional ㄹ is inserted into the stem before adding ~ㄹ/을 겁니다. Additionally, 르 changes to 라 or 러 based on the preceding vowel.
irregulars.example: 다르다 (to be different) becomes 달을 겁니다.
